entities.name: Upper Videnth
entities.description: Large peninsula jutting south from Dominaria's arctic northern supercontinent, colonized from the island of Videnth.

entities.name: Videnth
entities.description: Island of a long-dead civilization that colonized Upper Videnth.

entities.name: Garan Elves
entities.description: Elves of Tamingazin said to come from the far north, likely Upper Videnth.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent near Upper Videnth overrun by glaciers in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era in which glaciers overran most of Terisiare.

events.summary: Glaciers overran most of Terisiare in the Ice Age, owing to its proximity to Upper Videnth.
events.quote: Upper Videnth's proximity to Terisiare is what allowed glaciers to overrun most of the continent during the Ice Age

events.summary: Cut off from their homeland, Upper Videnth's human descendants forgot why the land was named so.
events.quote: these descendants of Videnth's colonizers eventually forgot why their land was called Upper Videnth

relations.quote: This would indicate that they originated in Upper Videnth.
